name: bld2_rat_sq_add_sq_ne_prime_mul_coprime
statement: (p m : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (h3 : p % 4 = 3) (hm : ¬ p ∣ m) (x y : ℚ) : x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≠ (p : ℚ) * (m : ℚ)
closed: ∀ (p m : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (h3 : p % 4 = 3) (hm : ¬ p ∣ m) (x y : ℚ), x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≠ (p : ℚ) * (m : ℚ)
informal: Uses Mathlib2.nt2_prime_three_mod_four_dvd_sq_add_sq (generalising Mathlib2.bld_rat_sq_add_sq_ne_prime_three_mod_four): clear denominators to a^2 + b^2 = p * m * d^2 in ℤ with d ≠ 0; by strong induction on |d| (or on the p-adic valuation), p ∣ a and p ∣ b, so p^2 ∣ p * m * d^2, so p ∣ d (as p ∤ m), and dividing a, b, d by p gives a smaller solution.
type: ∀ (p m : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p % 4 = 3 → ¬p ∣ m → ∀ (x y : ℚ), x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≠ ↑p * ↑m
